text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Harare city council has failed to clear Zimbabwe's capital of children who make a living out of street-begging because their parents keep sending them back, Harare Executive Mayor Solomon Tawengwa said.
- Zimbabwe police have smashed one of Harare's largest illicit beer breweries and arrested dozens of people during raids on the capital's outskirts and some inner poor townships.
